events.verdict: RAR shows Embiid (PHI) loses control of the ball on his own and not as a result of any contact from Prince (ATL).

[Observable in enhanced video] RLS shows Huerter (ATL) gathers the loose ball in the backcourt with both hands and proceeds to dribble with his left hand.  As he enters the frontcourt, he re-gathers the ball with both hands and resumes his dribble.
Butler (PHI) legally contests Huerter's (ATL) shot near the rim.
Redick (PHI) is already in Huerter's (ATL) path when contact occurs and he does not deliver contact.
LAR shows Dedmon (ATL) maintains legal guarding position and makes incidental contact with Embiid (PHI) that does not affect his SQBR.
LAR shows Simmons (PHI) makes contact to Young's (ATL) arm, affecting his dribbles and SQBR.
Young (ATL) wraps Butler (PHI) in the backcourt.
Collins (ATL) is already in Redick's (PHI) path when contact occurs and he does not deliver contact.  Additionally, Collins does not clamp Redick's arm as they disengage after the pick.
Young (ATL) places his hand momentarily on Redick's (PHI) hip before correcting.
Dedmon (ATL) legally contests Butler's (PHI) shot attempt.
LAR shows Young (ATL) maintains legal guarding position as he defends Butler's (PHI) driving shot attempt.
[Observable in enhanced video} Butler (PHI) gathers the ball on his left foot, establishing his right foot as his pivot foot.  Butler lifts his pivot foot at the start of his dribble.
LLB shows Dedmon (ATL) makes contact with Butler (PHI) that causes him to lose control of the ball.
Ennis III (PHI) places his hand momentarily on Huerter's (ATL) side before correcting.
Dedmon (ATL) is already in Ennis III's (PHI) path when contact occurs and he does not deliver contact.
[Observable in enhanced video] Prince (ATL) slides his pivot foot at the start of his dribble.
LAR and RLB show Harris (PHI) maintains legal guarding position as he defends Prince's (ATL) driving shot attempt.
[Observable in enhanced video] Collins (ATL) fails to fully clear the lane and is in the paint for longer than three seconds without imminently actively guarding an opponent.
Ennis III (PHI) is already in Huerter's (ATL) path when contact occurs and he does not deliver contact.
Huerter (ATL) makes incidental contact with Ennis III (PHI) that does not affect his SQBR on the perimeter.
Correctly called 24 second violation.
Embiid (PHI) and Collins (ATL) briefly engage and disengage during the inbound.
Butler (PHI) maintains legal guarding position as he defends Young's (ATL) shot attempt.
Len (ATL) cleanly deflects the ball away from Marjanovic (PHI).
Collins (ATL) maintains legal guarding position and does not affect Marjanovic's (PHI) ability to get to the pass.
